topic.title: Winter War 1939-40: Mainila shots, Terijoki government, who won

queries.text: Winter War 1939 Mainila shelling, Terijoki government and who won
talvisota Mainilan laukaukset Terijoen hallitus kuka voitti
Soviet attack on Finland in 1939: pretext and outcome
vinterkriget skotten i Mainila Terijokiregeringen vem vann

items.label: contested
items.description: Changes the infobox result from 'Moscow Peace' to 'Soviet victory (military), Finnish defensive victory (political), Moscow Peace'.
items.why: Level 2. Claim, quoted from the added infobox line: 'Neuvostoliiton voitto (sotilaallinen), Suomen torjuntavoitto (poliittinen)' ('Soviet victory (military), Finnish defensive victory (political)'), i.e. who won. Community dispute: an edit war on 2010-08-27/28. Added 4 times (8960158, 8960194, 8962713 by E201; 8963132 by E203) and removed 4 times by two other accounts (E134 twice, E202 twice). Removal summaries include 'rv, epämääräisiä käsitteitä' ('rv, vague concepts') and 'lähteet ensin' ('sources first'). Each version stayed 116 s to 6.2 h. Candidates c19, c20, c21, c03 are the inserting side; c17, c18, c02 are the same war seen from the removing side. Not level 3: E201 and E203 are both in 85.76.x.x (one editor), one article, all insertions within 14 h (< 7 days), no source change. Not kept (flag added_text_in_latest_revision not set).

items.label: contested
items.description: Rewrites 'the Russians have later admitted it was an artillery strike staged by the Soviet Union' to 'have not admitted' and adds 'This historical fact is still disputed', citing the article's existing rkka.ru reference.
items.why: Level 2. Claim: changes 'Venäläiset ovat myöhemmin myöntäneet' ('the Russians have later admitted') to 'Venäläiset eivät ole myöntäneet' ('the Russians have not admitted') that the shelling was staged, and adds 'Tämä historiallinen fakta on edelleen kiistanalainen' ('This historical fact is still disputed'), attached to the rkka.ru reference that the article cites for Aptekar's conclusion that the shots were staged. Community dispute: put back twice (15356377, 15356383) and removed three times by E270 with sourcing summaries: 'lähteetön' ('unsourced'), 'ylen lähteessä asiaa ei mainita' ('the Yle source does not mention it'), 'ylen lähde on kuitenkin viitteenä tässä, korjaa' ('the Yle source is still cited here, fix it'). The inserter's summaries call the Yle source 'spekulaatiota' ('speculation'). Candidates c04, c22, c23 (same text each time). Not level 3: one account (E404), one article, all insertions within 94 minutes on 2015-11-25; the re-used citation could at most be the sources signal, and level 3 needs an editors or articles signal too. Note: the original sentence already carried {{lähde tarkemmin|Asia ei selviä lähteestä}} ('cite more precisely: the source does not show this') dated 17.4.2015, before this episode.

items.label: contested
items.description: Adds that Mannerheim favoured the Soviet territorial-exchange offer, that foreign minister Erkko forbade him to make it public, that 85,000 people paid with their lives for 'Erkko's stupidity', and that Erkko was 'the number one war criminal'.
items.why: Level 2. Claim, one-sided framing quoted from the added text: 'Valitettavasti neuvottelut lopetettiin, Suomi joutui sotaan ja 85 000 ihmistä sai maksaa hengellään Erkon tyhmyyden' ('Unfortunately the negotiations were ended, Finland was drawn into war and 85,000 people had to pay with their lives for Erkko's stupidity') and 'Tosiasiaksi jää että Erkko oli numero yksi sotarikollinen' ('The fact remains that Erkko was the number one war criminal'). Community dispute: put back once after a removal. Added by E91 (2940776), removed by E93 after 3.3 h (2942005), put back by E94 (2942369, an undo of that removal) and removed by E95 110 s later (2942380), all on 2007-05-31; both removals are plain undo summaries. Candidates c10, c25. Not level 3: two distinct inserting editors (E91 anonymous 81.229.x.x, E94 named) is one signal, but one article, one re-insertion on the same day and no source change, so only one of the four signals.

items.label: contested
items.description: Adds two paragraphs on Häyhä's kill count: a 1941 Hurtti Ukko interview (headline '600 kills for sure', 259 with his rifle, a record of 40 in one day) and a 1940 book saying he shot more enemies than could be counted.
items.why: Level 2. Claim: kill-count figures presented as 'Yksi luotettavimmista Häyhää koskevista tiedoista' ('one of the most reliable pieces of information about Häyhä'), e.g. 'Jutun otsikossa mainitaan 600 tappoa "varman päälle"' ('the article's headline mentions 600 kills "for sure"'). Community dispute: removal summary about sourcing, 'sodanaikaisen propagandan alaiset julkaisut eivät ole asiassa luotettavia, anekdoottina mielenkiintoisia kunhan lähde+sivunro' ('publications subject to wartime propaganda are not reliable on this; interesting as an anecdote given source + page number'); the same text was put back once (7716568) and removed again 'kuten aikaisempi' ('like the previous one'). Stayed 8.1 h and 4.7 h. Candidates c07, c08. Not level 3: one account (E485), one article, both insertions within 14 h.

items.label: contested
items.description: Adds that hatred of Russians ('ryssäviha', i.e. racism) was one key to success in the war and that soldiers fought against 'an inferior people and culture'.
items.why: Level 2. Claim, narrative framing quoted from the added text: 'Ryssäviha lue rasismi oli yksi menestymisen tae sodassa' ('Hatred of Russians, read: racism, was one guarantee of success in the war') and 'Taisteltiin alempiarvoista kansaa ja kultturia vastaan tunnontuskista piittaamatta' ('They fought against an inferior people and culture without qualms of conscience'). Community dispute: the removal summary is about sourcing and neutrality, 'Lähteetön mielipidekirjoitus' ('unsourced opinion piece'), removed by a different account (E78) after 2 minutes. Candidate c27 (look-alike bucket 'short-lived substantive'); the short exposure does not lower the level under the evidence standard. Not level 3: one anonymous editor (146.81.x.x), one article, never put back.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Changes the infobox casus belli from the Mainila shots to the Terijoki government's request for help to the Soviet Union in its declaration of 1 December 1939.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive change to the stated cause of the war, removed by a different account (E147) after 6.4 h. The added text is a claim, but the pack shows no community-dispute signal: the removal summary is a plain undo plus 'Kts. keskustelu' ('see the talk page'), which names no accuracy, neutrality or sourcing reason; never put back (flag removal_was_itself_undone not set); no edit war or dispute template in the episode. The inserter's summary gives a reason: 'Terijoen hallituksen perustamisen tarkoitus oli oikeuttaa talvisota esittämällä, että NL toimi Suomen työläisten kutsun perusteella' ('the purpose of setting up the Terijoki government was to justify the Winter War by presenting the USSR as acting on the invitation of Finland's workers'). Candidate c01. Would rise to level 2 only if the talk-page thread (not in the pack) shows an accuracy or neutrality dispute.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Rewrites the list of ceded areas and the other peace terms from the Finlex treaty text (e.g. 'non-alignment against the Soviet Union' becomes 'mutual non-alignment') and replaces the external links.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive, sourced rewrite (14736665 by E422, 14947746 by E423) removed after 63 days by E138 with 'rv, eston kiertoa' ('rv, block evasion'); put back once unchanged by E424 (14949245, summary 'runnygnome') and removed 13 min later by E425 with no summary. Candidates c05, c24 (same chain). The removals give no accuracy, neutrality or sourcing reason and the text is ordinary sourced prose with no disputed claim, so it stays at level 1 despite the re-insertion (brief: block-evasion rollbacks of ordinary prose). E422, E423 and E424 are all in 85.76.x.x (one editor); the pack does not split which of the first two edits added which part, so both are listed.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds that the 'White Death' nickname may have come from the Finnish side and became popular only from 21 December 1939, citing a video episode.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive addition (22295376 plus the inserter's own typo fix 22295380, both E685) removed after 121 days by E287 in a rollback whose summary gives no reason. The inserter's summary says 'Voi olla että kaikki mitä kirjoitin ei ole 100% totta' ('it may be that not everything I wrote is 100% true'). No dispute signal: no removal reason, never put back, no template. Candidate c06. The other four edits swept away by the rollback (E684 +39 and E686 +12, each undone within minutes by E306 and E358) are not this content and are left out.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds ten self-published (Books on Demand) Winter War books by one author to the literature list and reformats one reference.
items.why: Level 1. Substantive (book titles, ISBNs) added in three edits by E354 and removed after 21 days by E38: 'omakustannespämmiä' ('self-published spam'). A bibliography addition, not a claim, so level 1. Candidate c09.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Rewrites infobox fields: lists the regions where the war was fought (South Karelia, Ladoga Karelia, North Karelia, Kainuu, Lapland) and changes the photo caption and the commander link.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive infobox change (region names) added by E243 (13353490), removed after 3.5 h by E124: 'kh ja w ongelmia, ei parannuksia' ('copy-editing and wikification problems, no improvements'); put back the next day by E244 (13357212, plus a +4-byte link tweak 13357246) and removed again by E124 (13357305): 'kh+w ongelmia' ('copy-editing and wikification problems'). E243 and E244 are both in 85.76.x.x (one editor). The removal reasons are about form, not accuracy, neutrality or sourcing, and the content is not a disputed claim, so level 1 despite the re-insertion. Candidates c26, c11 (same chain). E245's bolding fix (13357274) swept away by the same revert is left out; the paragraph removed in the same revert is winter-war/i11.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds a paragraph listing Finnish national-socialist parties of 1932–1944 and how they were dissolved, in the Finland–Germany relations section.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive paragraph (13357298 by E246, 85.76.x.x) removed 8 minutes later by E124 together with the infobox edits of winter-war/i10: 'asiaankuulumatonta lähteetöntä tekstiä' ('irrelevant unsourced text'). The removal mentions sourcing, but the text is an off-topic factual list with no contested claim about the war (careful reading: good-faith error), so it is capped at level 1. Candidate c11.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds that Simo Häyhä appears in the Japanese manga Record of Ragnarok, fighting the god Loki in round 11.
items.why: Level 1. Unsourced pop-culture trivia (23525415 by E700) removed after 7 days by E383 in a rollback with no reason; no dispute signal. Candidate c12. E699's '+Suomi' edit and E383's undo of it (23539382, 23539384) are swept-away edits, left out. Not merged with winter-war/i13 or winter-war/i18: those add other manga text in different words by other editors (2020, 2023).

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds that a manga by Naruki Nagakawa has a female sniper named Häyhä as its protagonist, citing a manga-hosting website.
items.why: Level 1. Pop-culture trivia (19012601 by E652, summary 'Lisännyt tiedon Häyhän tarkka-ampuja legendan siirtymisestä Japanilaiseen manga kulttuuriin' / 'added information on the Häyhä sniper legend passing into Japanese manga culture') removed 12 days later by E332: 'merkittävyys epäselvä' ('notability unclear'), a relevance reason. Never put back. Candidate c13. E651's five small lead edits (18974466–18974476, net −39 bytes, mostly deleting words such as 'Neuvostoliittoa vastaan käydyssä') were swept away by the same revert; they add no content and are left out.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds a rifle serial number and a paragraph saying Häyhä had no experience with scoped rifles and declined a captured Soviet scoped rifle at Kollaa.
items.why: Level 1. Substantive additions to the 'Taktiikka' section (18325402 by E638 and 18325428 by E639, both summarised 'Lisätty tietoa' / 'added information') removed after 15 days by E270: 'lähteistetty tekstiosuus jonka lähteessä tätä ei ole' ('a sourced passage whose source does not contain this'). The removal is about sourcing, but on a careful reading this is a plausible factual addition placed before a citation that does not support it, with no narrative and no back-and-forth, so it is a good-faith error capped at level 1 (when in doubt, the lower level). No citation was removed, replaced or made up, so not source manipulation. Never put back. Candidate c14.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Rewrites the lead to say the name 'Mannerheim Line' was given by foreign journalists and was not used in official Finnish usage.
items.why: Level 1. A substantive change to the lead (7718605 by E713, summary 'Mannerheim-linja on journalistinen nimitys' / 'Mannerheim Line is a journalistic name') removed after 2.9 h by E714: 'Lähteetön muutos pois' ('unsourced change removed'). The removal is about sourcing, but the addition is an unsourced statement about the name with no narrative push and no back-and-forth, so it is a good-faith error capped at level 1. Never put back. Candidate c16.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Changes the 'more accurate estimate' of Red Army soldiers Häyhä shot from about 200 to about 2,000.
items.why: Level 1. A number change (14105173 by E557, summary 'Vaihdoin ammuttujen sotilaiden numeron oikeaksi, sillä joku oli vandalisoinut sitä' / 'I changed the number of soldiers shot to the correct one, since someone had vandalised it') removed 12 min later by E138 in a rollback with no reason. Substantive (a number) and a factual claim; the new figure contradicts the same sentence's 'jopa 542' ('as many as 542'). No community-dispute signal (no reason given, never put back), so level 1. Candidate c35 (look-alike bucket 'small').

items.label: reverted
items.description: Changes four cited infobox figures: Finnish strength 250,000 to 90,000, Soviet strength 1,000,000 to 1,500,000, Finnish dead 26,662 to 20,000, Soviet dead 126,875 to 200,000.
items.why: Level 1. Number changes to cited figures (4257763, 4257774 by E131, no summary) removed 5 min later by E116: 'vandalismia pois' ('vandalism removed'). Substantive (numbers). The removal reason is vandalism, not accuracy, neutrality or sourcing, and it was never put back, so there is no level-2 signal. Not excluded as graffiti: the text is coherent figures, not obscenity or nonsense. Candidate c36 (look-alike bucket 'small').

items.label: reverted
items.description: Adds a popular-culture paragraph: a teenage sniper named Simo Häyhä in the manga Shiroi Majo, and Häyhä as one of humanity's fighters in the manga Record of Ragnarok.
items.why: Level 1. Partial-removal candidate c40: the paragraph was removed after 117 days by E681, '/* Simo Häyhä kulttuurissa */ Lähteetöntä' ('unsourced'). Inserting-edit check: 21205039 by E721 (+620 bytes, summary 'Simo Häyhä populaarikulttuurissa' / 'Simo Häyhä in popular culture') matches the removed paragraph's subject and most of its size; the pack has no diff of the insertion itself, so a reviewer should confirm it. Pop-culture trivia, not a claim, so level 1 despite the sourcing summary.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Adds that 'newer research' shows the Finns fired the Mainila shots as part of a Hitlerite plot and attacked the Soviet Union in 1939 with German, Namibian and American troops.
items.why: Excluded: graffiti. The added text is absurd ('suomalaiset hyökkäsivät Neuvostoliitton vuonna 1939 yhdessä saksalaisten, namibialaisten ja amerikkalaisten joukkojen kanssa', 'the Finns attacked the Soviet Union in 1939 together with German, Namibian and American troops'); careful-reader assessment: vandalism (joke), confidence 4 of 5. Removed after 3 min by a plain undo (E334). Even without the exclusion it would be level 1 only (no dispute signal). Candidate c30.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Replaces the infobox title, the image caption and the bold title in the lead with Russian-language obscenities and ethnic slurs.
items.why: Excluded: graffiti (Russian obscenities and slurs, no content). Removed after 73 s by E360's rollback. Candidate c28.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Inserts a dialect insult ('.saatanan ryssät hyökkäs suamee', 'damn [slur for Russians] attacked Finland') into a lead sentence.
items.why: Excluded: self-removal. The same account (E280) took it out 49 s later (16057903). It would also be graffiti. Candidate c31.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Adds a crude joke ('koska niille tuli levoton paskahätä', 'because they got restless diarrhoea') to the start-of-the-war section.
items.why: Excluded: self-removal. The same anonymous editor (E17) removed it 5 min later (197726). Candidate c32.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Adds the {{Tekijänoikeus_201009}} copyright-check template to the top of the article.
items.why: Excluded: bot. Added by the bot-like account E206 (flag bot_inserter true); template only, so it is also not substantive. Removed after 3.5 days by E209: 'crashin diffit ok. tekijänoikeusmalline pois' ('the flagged diffs are OK, copyright template removed'). The two edit/undo pairs swept away by the same revert (E204/E205, E207/E208) net to zero and are left out. Candidate c33.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Replaces the whole article (−82,926 bytes) with the opening of an unrelated article about pornography.
items.why: Excluded: blanking (flag blanking true; the page content was replaced by unrelated text). Rolled back after 115 s by E120. Candidate c34. Same session as winter-war/n07.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Inserts keyboard mashing ('sdfsdf') and joke values into the infobox (an obscene casus belli; Soviet strength '2 unfortunate men, 0 tanks').
items.why: Excluded: graffiti (keyboard mashing and joke values). Four edits by E119 within 4 minutes, taken out by E120 (4099704, summary calls it vandalism). E120's intermediate rollback (4099699) is a restore, not an insertion, and E119's page replacement 4099689 is winter-war/n06. Candidate c37.

topic.notes: Labelled from research/20-golden/packs/winter-war.json only (pack built 2026-11-14T12:18:38Z). The three must_include_rev_ids are covered: 5892101 = i06, 8963132 = i01, 15356346 = i02. Simo Häyhä got pop-culture/manga text three times from three different editors in different words (i13 2020, i18 2023, i12 2025), each removed; kept as separate reverted items because the text is not the same and it is trivia, not a claim. The masked range 85.76.x.x accounts for many inserting pseudonyms in this topic (2010, 2013, 2015, 2020, 2025); it counts as one editor for level 3.

skipped.reason: The inserting edit 18790337 is itself a rollback ('rv, eston kiertoa (E168)' / 'rv, block evasion') that restored older text, and its removal 18792202 put the rolled-back version back. The content actually added and taken out (that other version) has no inserting edits in the pack, so no item can be built.

Not confident: a one-line unsourced anecdote ('Eräässä helsinkiläisessä ravintolassa oli lounaaksi merkitty paistettua varista', 'a Helsinki restaurant had fried crow on the lunch menu') added to the bibliography section and the consequences section 44 s apart and removed within 2 min ('rv'). It could be test/nonsense (graffiti) or unsourced trivia (level 1); my graffiti confidence is about 3 of 5, right on the threshold.

Tangled net-0-byte chain: E121's same-length number edits, E119/E120 vandalism and rollbacks, and E122's 'rv pidemmälle, lähteistetyn tiedon muuttamista' ('rv further, changing of sourced information'). The c37 and c38 diffs disagree on which revision held 330 000 vs 250 000 men, and who undid E123's removal is not in the pack, so the inserting edit and the direction of the change cannot be established.

Inserting edit found by text search did not add the removed text: 20347293 (E720, +79 bytes, 'välilyönnit, ulkoiset linkit' / 'spaces, external links'). The removal diff is truncated in the pack and the visible part shows only reference-format changes and {{Lähde}} tags.
Inserting edit found by text search did not add the removed text: 6148195 is −8 bytes, so it only edited the removed paragraph (Palle's song on Yle radio), which existed before.
Inserting edit found by text search did not add the removed text: 5376616 is +22 bytes, while the removed paragraph (Soviet bounty on Häyhä) is about 400 bytes and existed before.
Inserting edit found by text search did not add the removed text: 4486930 is −1 byte, while the removed paragraph (Häyhä's 1998 'Harjoitus' answer) is 351 bytes.
